cadence.how: Dial by hand. Opener, the 3 questions, then the close. No answer: leave the voicemail once, log Voicemail.
Only if they said yes, or a public business email is on their listing: 'Email them the link' in the portal (agency Gmail, honest subject, postal address, opt-out).
ONLY if they said 'text it to me' on the call: send it by hand from your Google Voice number, log 'they said I can text'. Never a cold text.
The one follow-up call, only after Voicemail / no answer / 'call me back' (2+ business days later; the portal counts). Never a third call.
Follow-up email #2 (the email autopilot sends it from the portal log; the caller does nothing): 'Did you get a chance to look?'
Last email (autopilot): 'I'll close your file; the link stays up for 30 days.' Then nothing, ever, unless they write back.

stop_words: Any 'no', 'not interested', 'take me off', 'don't call' = log No / Do not call at once: no more calls, texts or emails, on any channel.
